import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD1 = 998244353;
    static final int MOD2 = 1000000007;
    static long n;
    static int[] digits = new int[15];
    static int[] base = new int[15];
    static int answer = 0;
    static int[] diff = new int[15];
    static int[] q1 = new int[1000010];
    static int[] q2 = new int[1000010];
    static long[] q2sum = new long[1000010];

    static long getNumber(int[] arr, int length) {
        long result = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= length; i++)
            result = result * 10 + arr[i];
        return result;
    }

    static long computeRank(int[] arr, int length) {
        long total = 0;
        for (int digit = 1; digit <= digits[0]; digit++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= Math.min(length, digit); i++) {
                for (int j = (i == 1 ? 1 : 0); j < arr[i]; j++) {
                    long leftPart = 0, rightPart = 0;
                    for (int p = 1; p < i; p++)
                        leftPart = rightPart = leftPart * 10 + arr[p];
                    leftPart = rightPart = leftPart * 10 + j;
                    for (int p = i + 1; p <= digit; p++)
                        leftPart = leftPart * 10;
                    for (int p = i + 1; p <= digit; p++)
                        rightPart = rightPart * 10 + 9;
                    rightPart = Math.min(rightPart, n);
                    if (leftPart <= rightPart)
                        total += rightPart - leftPart + 1;
                }
            }
            if (digit <= length)
                total++;
        }
        return total;
    }

    static int computeF(int[] arr, int length) {
        long res = (-getNumber(arr, length) + computeRank(arr, length)) % MOD1;
        if (res < 0) res += MOD1;
        return (int) res;
    }

    static void dfs(int start, int end, int[] q, int v) {
        if (start == end) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++)
                q[++q[0]] = (int) ((v + 1L * i * diff[start]) % MOD1);
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++)
            dfs(start + 1, end, q, (int) ((v + 1L * i * diff[start]) % MOD1));
    }

    static void update(int length, int index, int value) {
        int[] backup = Arrays.copyOf(digits, digits.length);
        digits[index] = value;
        for (int p = index + 1; p <= length; p++)
            digits[p] = 0;
        int baseVal = computeF(digits, length);
        for (int p = index + 1; p <= length; p++) {
            digits[p] = 1;
            diff[p] = (computeF(digits, length) + MOD1 - baseVal) % MOD1;
            digits[p] = 0;
        }
        if (length - index == 0) {
            answer = (answer + baseVal) % MOD2;
            return;
        }
        if (length - index == 1) {
            for (int p = 0; p <= 9; p++)
                answer = (answer + (baseVal + 1L * p * diff[length]) % MOD1) % MOD2;
            return;
        }
        int mid = (length + index) / 2;
        q1[0] = 0;
        q2[0] = 0;
        dfs(index + 1, mid, q1, baseVal);
        dfs(mid + 1, length, q2, 0);
        Arrays.sort(q2, 1, q2[0] + 1);
        long sumQ2 = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= q2[0]; i++)
            sumQ2 = (sumQ2 + q2[i]) % MOD2;
        for (int i = 1; i <= q1[0]; i++) {
            int p = lowerBound(q2, 1, q2[0], MOD1 - q1[i]);
            answer = (int) ((answer + sumQ2 + 1L * q2[0] * q1[i]) % MOD2);
            answer = (int) ((answer + 1L * (q2[0] - p + 1) * (MOD2 - MOD1)) % MOD2);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(int[] arr, int start, int end, int target) {
        int low = start, high = end;
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (arr[mid] >= target)
                high = mid;
            else
                low = mid + 1;
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        long m = n;
        int len = 0;
        while (m > 0) {
            digits[++len] = (int) (m % 10);
            m /= 10;
        }
        digits[1] = 0; // Adjusting for 1-based indexing
        for (int i = 1; i <= len / 2; i++) {
            int temp = digits[i];
            digits[i] = digits[len - i + 1];
            digits[len - i + 1] = temp;
        }
        digits[0] = len; // Store length at index 0
        for (int d = 1; d <= digits[0]; d++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= d; i++) {
                int l = (i == 1 ? 1 : 0);
                int r = (d == digits[0] ? digits[i] - 1 : 9);
                for (int j = l; j <= r; j++) {
                    if (j != digits[i]) {
                        update(d, i, j);
                    }
                }
            }
            answer = (answer + computeF(digits, d)) % MOD2;
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
